knowledge.text: The last day to add or drop a course without a transcript notation is September 14. The last day to withdraw from a course is November 6. Dates apply to the Fall 2026 term. Check with Academic Operations for exceptions.
knowledge.title: Add and drop deadlines

knowledge.text: Final examinations for Fall 2026 run from December 14 to December 21. The examination timetable is published by Academic Operations. Conflicts must be reported before the add and drop deadline.
knowledge.title: Final examination period

knowledge.text: A full-time load is 12 credits or more in a semester term. Taking more than 18 credits requires advisor approval. Course credits are shown beside each course title.
knowledge.title: Credit load policy

knowledge.text: The library is open 08:00 to 22:00 on weekdays. Group study rooms seat 4 to 8 people and can be reserved for up to 2 hours per day. Quiet floors are marked at the entrance.
knowledge.title: Library hours and study rooms

knowledge.text: Report Wi-Fi or classroom technology problems to the IT Service Desk. Include the building, the room and the time. Outages are posted on the service status page.
knowledge.title: Wi-Fi and technology help

knowledge.text: Report heating, cooling, lighting, or accessibility problems to Facilities with the building and room. Urgent safety issues must be reported to campus safety instead.
knowledge.title: Reporting a building or room problem

knowledge.text: Student parking permits are sold online for the Fall 2026 term. Campus shuttles run every 15 minutes on weekdays. Bicycle racks are located at each residence and the library.
knowledge.title: Parking and transportation

knowledge.text: Students who need academic accommodations should contact Accessibility Services early in the term. Instructors receive accommodation letters through the official process, not from students directly.
knowledge.title: Accessibility and accommodations
